description: Armor/shield registry - see CLAUDE.md's Armor section for authoring guidelines. Armor grants Block (heavy armor/shields) or Dodge (light armor) only while equipped, and passively reduces incoming damage by damageReduction while equipped, regardless of which skill was rolled to defend.

armor.name: Leather Armor
armor.description: Simple, flexible protection stitched from boiled leather. Light enough to duck and weave in.

armor.name: Chainmail
armor.description: Interlocking steel rings, heavy but dependable against a glancing blow.

armor.name: Plate Armor
armor.description: A full suit of fitted steel plate. Slow going, but very little gets through it.

armor.name: Wooden Buckler
armor.description: A small round shield, strapped to the forearm. Cheap, light, and just enough to catch a blade.

armor.name: Tower Shield
armor.description: A wall of banded steel nearly as tall as its bearer. Exhausting to hold up, but almost nothing gets past it.
